name: handover
wording: What one party passes to another; each role is defined by what it receives and what it hands over, never by steps. A handover is a story, a task, a pull request, a review, an outcome or a read-back, and each states what it must contain, so one passed without a part shows what is missing.
reason: The operator, 2026-10-15: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure; each role is defined by what it receives and hands over, each handover states what it must contain, and established practice is named rather than restated.
